scenes.title: A day in operations
scenes.subtitle: Deepa runs the Kochi desk
scenes.narration: Deepa runs operations at the Kochi desk. Once a trip is sold, she makes sure it happens: cars, vouchers, visas and the tasks in between.
She starts on the fleet dashboard: trips running today, cars free, and alerts that need her.
The trip list shows each pickup with its driver and status, updated live as drivers move through the trip.
A hotel has confirmed, so she marks the voucher confirmed.
Her tasks are on a board by status. She moves one along as it gets done.
And she checks the visa dashboard for applications waiting on documents.

scenes.headline: Sold trips that run smoothly.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. Sold trips that run smoothly.
